dialogue: ...Hey! Wake up!

Good, you're alive! The sorcerer here captured you and threw you into this cell. You've been unconscious ever since. Lucky for you, I just finished an escape tunnel. I'm breaking out now. Come with me.
All right, I'll go ahead. Oh, and it looks like they confiscated your sword and shield. You shouldn't wander around this tower unarmed.

Hey, we meet again! Thanks for taking out the gatekeeper. I messed up and got caught again, and this time they locked me in a cell deep inside. Anyway, I've dug a tunnel leading to the dragon on floor 35. I'll open it up, so go on ahead.
I'll catch up with you. Go ahead to floor 35.
Thank you for rescuing me. As a reward, I'll increase your attack and defense by 3%. (Your attack and defense increased!)
Thanks for helping me. It isn't much, but please accept this as a reward. (You received 1,000 gold!)
Zeno the Sorcerer: Welcome to the Magic Tower. You are its hundredth intruder. Ordinarily I would leave you to my servants, but this time I shall deal with you myself. Curse your own misfortune!
What?! Aaah!
I bestow upon you the Hero's Orb. With it, you can save your game, inspect the monsters on your current floor, and predict the damage they will deal. Use it wisely.
Heh heh, you've done well to get this far. I suppose I'll have to face you myself... but first, show me what you can do! Come forth, skeleton soldiers!
Not bad... But you shall go no farther! This is where I bury you! Come and fight!
Ugh... So you managed to defeat me... But beyond here await enemies and traps far stronger than any you've faced. Watch your step...
Hey, you again! Impressive work, beating this section's boss. I was stuck here too, unable to reach the upper floors.
Hey! You're still alive? That giant octopus was blocking my way, but I've finally finished a tunnel. You should leave the octopus for later too. See you around!
Well, you found me. As a reward, take this Elixir. It restores HP according to your attack and defense when you use it. Naturally, the longer you wait, the more effective it will be.
So you're the hero who defeated the skeletons and broke in... Don't lump me in with those weaklings. Let me show you the power of one who is all but immortal. Come!
Ugh... I never thought even I would fall... Your strength is real, it seems. But you're still no match for the Archsorcerer. Enjoy your brief victory while it lasts...
...HERO...KILL...
...THE TIME HAS COME...CHOSEN ONE, IF YOU DO NOT FEAR DEATH, PASS THROUGH THE GATE OF TIME AND SPACE AND COME TO ME...
This is... a doll!
Ah! I hadn't finished the tunnel yet... If you'd waited a little longer, you wouldn't have needed that item. This throws off the plan... Never mind.
At last, the tunnel is finished. Oh, you again! Good timing. I've made another passage. Use it as you please.
The final boss and the captive princess should be in this section, but you're probably not ready to fight him yet.
So you're the hero who beat the bosses of the first two sections and climbed this far. Your journey ends here! As this section's boss, I'll take your head myself! Prepare yourself!
Ugh... I'll let you off this time... If you make it to floor 40, I'll fight you seriously! Remember that!
There you are. I've opened the tunnel as promised. It takes you behind the dragon; you can reach the upper floors from there.
The Golden Knight, this section's boss, is weak but full of himself. Apparently Zeno the Sorcerer, the tower's second in command, can't stand him.
So you've come. This time will be different! I'll repay this humiliation tenfold! Ghost soldiers, charge!
Hmph, that was just a warm-up! Soldiers, charge!
We're only getting started! Swordsmen, charge!
Grr... Try this! Knights, charge!
You... my men... I'll never forgive you! This time I'm holding nothing back! Prepare yourself!
Cough... That's enough for now... pant, pant... I'll let you off... But next time, I'll really, truly fight you seriously! Be ready!
Golden Knight: Ah... Lord Zeno... I almost had the hero, but he escaped. Please forgive me...
Zeno the Sorcerer: He escaped? You're the one who ran away! You shameless fool! This tower has no use for a coward like you! Die!
Golden Knight: Please, forgive... Aaaargh!
Zeno the Sorcerer: Forgive that ugly scene. Rest assured, I am nothing like that piece of trash. If you make it to the top, I shall face you myself. I'll be waiting...
Zeno the Sorcerer: Well done, reaching this place. You have my praise. As promised, I shall face you myself. Come!
Zeno the Sorcerer: That formation... This is bad!
Hero: You...! What are you doing here?
Thief: Heh heh... There can be only one reason I'm here. This!
Hero: Ah! You're Zeno! You're alive?!
Zeno the Sorcerer: Did you think that would kill me? I was merely testing your intelligence as a warrior.
Hero: What?! What do you mean? Why go to all this trouble?

Zeno the Sorcerer: The divine sword Weaponer that you bear, and the omnipotent staff Intellion that I wield... It is said that when their powers unite, one can obtain great wisdom. But that requires a warrior capable of drawing out the sword's full power.
Hero: And you're saying that warrior is me...?
Zeno the Sorcerer: Yes... But your skill was not yet sufficient to master the divine sword Weaponer.
Hero: Then the story about the kidnapped princess was a trap to lure me here?!

Zeno the Sorcerer: Precisely. Once I absorb your power, this farce will be over. The time has come... With my omnipotent power, I shall shatter the divine sword and obtain great wisdom... Come, warrior of the divine sword!
I believe there's a sword on floor 5 and a shield on floor 9. Get those first. See you around!
Oh, I heard there's a shield on floor 11 and a sword on floor 17. They say you should get the sword first, so slip past the enemies and go for it. I'm off!
So I spread false rumors, set traps throughout this tower, and waited for you. Just as planned, you've reached me with the strength to wield the divine sword.
I have nothing to tell you. There should be a hidden message on this floor.
Zeno the Sorcerer: Cough! Curse you! To think I would be defeated... But this will not kill me! I look forward to the day we fight again!
Besides doors that open with keys, this tower has gates. To open one, you must defeat the monsters guarding it.
After you buy something from a merchant, you can hear important information from them.
This tower has 50 floors, divided into sections of ten floors each. Every section has a boss; you must defeat that boss to reach the floors above.
When donating at an altar, you should mainly improve your defense. But if you never improve your attack, you may eventually face enemies you cannot defeat.
Have you noticed the secret passages on floors 9, 16, and 18?
Carrying the Cross doubles your attack against zombies and vampires. The vampire in particular will be hard to defeat without it. They say it's somewhere on a higher floor...
They say there are two places to find red keys in this section.
In this section, you may need several attack upgrades from the altar to defeat the monsters called Rocks. Be careful.
The Archsorcerer, master of the Magic Tower, is in this section. Fighting him as you are now would be suicide. For now, find a way past him into the section above.
At this point, 1,500 HP, 80 attack, 98 defense, five ordinary keys, and one purple key would be almost ideal.
The swordsman who fights with two swords has extremely high attack. A normal fight will cost you dearly. Avoid him until you can defeat him in one strike.
This tower has 50 floors, but it seems you can only reach floor 49.
When you're in a hurry, take the long way round.
Use this floor's four secret passages wisely, and you can reach the upper floors without fighting the strongest enemies.
You need the Mattock to get the treasure in this floor's treasury.
Wherever there's a gatekeeper, there's a gate. And wherever there's a gate, an enemy guards it. So...
At three o'clock, the treasure of spatial travel will appear.
Somewhere in this tower is a Lucky Gold Coin. Carrying it doubles the gold you receive for defeating enemies.
Magicians attack with magic when you stand next to them. Sorcerers halve your HP when you stand between two of them. The more HP you have, the more that pincer attack costs you. Be careful.
Floor 44 is a phantom floor. Ordinary stairs cannot take you there. You'll have to warp to reach it.
The Divine Shield can protect you from spellcasters' magic attacks... But they say it's hidden on the phantom floor.
Floor 41 is perfectly symmetrical from left to right. So...
To defeat the dragon, you should have the Holy Sword, Holy Shield, and Dragon Slayer, as well as considerable strength.
They say the pattern of five dots on a die can seal away evil. Remember that when you face this section's boss.
That's all I have to say.
Thank you for rescuing me. As a reward, I'll increase your attack and defense by 3%. (Your attack and defense increased!)
I bestow upon you the Hero's Orb. It lets you save your game, inspect this floor's monsters, and predict damage. Use it wisely.
Well, you found me. As a reward, take this Elixir. It restores HP according to your attack and defense when you use it. Naturally, the longer you wait, the more effective it will be.
I have nothing more to say.
Use it well!
You have run out of HP! Please try again.

ending_story:
The long battle is over; the tower of vanity crumbles.

The gods return to the heavens,
and the warrior returns to the earth.

The present slips into the past,
and this journey, too, is becoming a memory.

You pause to look back,
then take your first step toward a new journey.
